premises.evidence_span: discovery is still a big unsolved problem

premises.text: Discovery quality depends more on getting good behavioral and trusted-social data than on tuning recommender algorithms

premises.evidence_span: We give you the most important dimensions of relevance, and then you can decide where you want to buy it based on pricing and accessibility
